title: FBI-UAP-D027, Digital Rendering, “Dark Translucent Triangle,” 2023
doc_notes: This document consists of five pages of digital renderings created by the FBI in 2026 to illustrate a UAP sighting reported in October 2023 near Colorado Springs.

incidents.summary: A reported UAP sighting in a residential backyard in Colorado Springs, described as a dark, translucent, trapezoidal or rectangular object with horizontal or vertical banding.
incidents.quote: a glowing, semi-transparent, trapezoidal or disc-shaped object characterized by distinct horizontal banding
